text: Try a better quality cover not this one.. I purchased this for my mom who loves this, but if you have any pets she says (she has 4 dogs) don't buy it shows so easily pet, & nail marks as well as dog hair. She also stated that you can see the matress itself through this cover it's so thin.

product_metadata.title: Nirvana Futons Grantoli Mist Queen Futon Mattress Cover (60-inch x 80-Inch) - Proudly Made in USA
features: Grantoli Mist Queen Futon Mattress Cover - This cover fully encases an industry standard queen futon mattress of 60" x 80" up to 8" thick.
The fabric consists shades of Red, Coral, Green, Teal. Multi-sided zipper futon covers are easy to put on and remove, making cleaning a breeze.
Quality made in USA - Guaranteed against defects and workmanship for as long as you own the cover!
Recommended Care: Machine wash with cold water and hang dry, no dryer

Your futon cover does not only protect your mattress and extend its life, it also offers countless decorating ideas for your home. Redesign and give any room a new look by just changing your cover. Matching pillows are also available.
description: Calming seaside design. Fabric colors include: Red, Coral, Green, Teal. All futon covers are made to order to provide the highest quality construction. Standard covers fit 6" - 8" futon mattress. 3 sided zipper-flap for easy removal (chair, loveseats and ottomans have 2-sided zipper). The cover totally encases the mattress similar to a duvet. Covers are serged and safety stitched for durability. Made in the U.S.A. Lifetime guarantee from defects on workmanship and materials. Fabric content: 100% Polyester Recommended Care: Machine wash with cold water and hang dry, no dryer
To ensure a proper fit, be sure to measure your futon mattress before ordering. The majority of returns are due to incorrect ordering.

How to determine the correct futon cover for your futon mattress: 1. Lay your futon mattress on a flat surface. 2. Measure the widest length and width. 3. Measure the height of the mattress at the highest point. Our covers will accommodate up to an 8" thick futon mattress. 4. Compare the length and width to the sizing chart below. Note: futon mattresses can expand or contract over time, therefore you may need to measure the footprint of the base to assist in determining the needed.  28" x 54" - Chair 28" x 21" - Chair Ottoman 54" x 54" - Loveseat 54" x 21" - Loveseat Ottoman 39" x 75" - Twin 54" x 75" - Full 60" x 80" - Queen
